title: A concentration result for multilayer feedforward neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.15335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider for an arbitrary fixed $\rho$ and for each positive integer $n$ a multilayer feedforward artificial neural network with $\rho$ layers, $n$ neurons in the first layer (the input layer) and only one neuron, the output neuron, in the last layer. Very roughly formulated, the main result is that if the distribution of weights of connections from a layer to the next are, for all large $n$, approximated well by a fixed continuous (but otherwise arbitrary) curve which does not depend on $n$, and if the values of the $n$ input neurons are independently and identically distributed with a continuous probability density function, then there is a number $\psi$ such that for all $\varepsilon > 0$ the probability that the value of the output neuron is in $[\psi - \varepsilon, \psi + \varepsilon]$ tends to 1 as $n$ tends to infinity.

translated_title: 多层前馈神经网络的浓度结果
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15335v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们考虑对于任意固定的ρ和每个正整数n，一个具有ρ层、第一层（输入层）有n个神经元、最后一层只有一个输出神经元的多层前馈人工神经网络。粗略地表述，主要结果是：如果对于所有较大的n，从一层到下一层的连接权重分布被一条不依赖于n的固定连续（但任意）曲线很好地近似，并且n个输入神经元的值独立同分布且具有连续概率密度函数，则存在一个数ψ，使得对于所有ε > 0，当n趋于无穷时，输出神经元的值落在[ψ - ε, ψ + ε]中的概率趋近于1。
tldr: 该论文证明了在权重分布近似连续曲线且输入独立同分布的条件下，多层前馈神经网络的输出值在n增大时收敛到某个固定值，具有概率浓度性质。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that under conditions where weight distributions approximate a continuous curve and inputs are i.i.d., the output of multilayer feedforward neural networks converges to a fixed value with probability concentration as n increases.
